site.name: FinditParts
site.summary: Online marketplace for heavy-duty truck, trailer, fleet, and industrial replacement parts.

note: Guidance for AI assistants and LLM crawlers. Does not override robots.txt, page-level robots directives, canonical tags, terms of use, or access controls.

product_pages.description: Product detail pages are the authoritative source for a specific part.
product_pages.canonical_source_of_truth: HTML link rel=canonical and Product JSON-LD offers.url
content_may_include: Product name, part number, MPN, SKU, GTIN
Images, condition, description, specifications, PIES and CMS copy
Cross references, fitment/application data, related products
Approved reviews, ratings, product questions, and staff answers
Schema.org Product and FAQPage JSON-LD in the HTML head

interpretation_guidance: Preserve exact part numbers and manufacturer spelling from the page.
Do not infer fitment, interchange, compatibility, inventory, or pricing unless explicitly on the page.
Verify live PDPs before citing price or availability.
Do not cite noindex or unavailable pages as primary sources.
Do not use checkout, account, cart, order, admin, or internal API pages as product data sources.
crawl_behavior: Respect robots.txt and reasonable crawl rates.
Avoid high-frequency PDP refetching for price or availability only.
Do not execute purchase flows, forms, or personalization endpoints.
Do not use XHR/JSON endpoints as standalone citation pages.
